card.name: Century digit in founding years
card.fires_on: The digit 9 (sometimes 0) in the middle of a four-digit year like 1968 or 2010. It appears mostly when the text says an organization or program was created, started or named.

modes.label: Year digit in founding dates
modes.description: The 9 or 0 inside a year, where an institution, program or name was created or changed.
modes.example: The FDP was created in 1<<9>>48 under the chairmanship of The

modes.label: Responsibility verb
modes.description: The word 'is' after an institution name, before a phrase about its responsibility.
modes.example: UCLA<< is>> responsible for overall Dawn mission science.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about founding, independence and affiliation, mostly Chinese terms such as 独立, 隶属 and 创办.
card.plain: It fires on the middle digit of a year when the text describes when an organization or program was founded.
